duas.ar: (.الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.en: All praise belongs to Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim. Rabbighfir li.
duas.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He has power over everything. Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no might and no power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.

duas.ar: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bi dhikrihi.
duas.en: All praise is for Allah, who gave me well-being in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.

duas.ar: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.tl: Inna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la-ayatin li-ulil-albab. Alladhina yadhkurunallaha qiyaman wa qu'udan wa 'ala junubihim wa yatafakkaruna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard. Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batila, subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar. Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytahu, wa ma lizzalimina min ansar. Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu bi-rabbikum fa-amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar. Rabbana wa atina ma wa'attana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad. Fastajaba lahum rabbuhum anni laudi'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min dhakarin aw untha, ba'dukum min ba'd. Fal-ladhina hajaru wa ukhriju min diyarihim wa udhu fi sabili wa qatalu wa qutilu la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'atihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anhar, thawaban min 'indillah, wallahu 'indahu husnuth-thawab. La yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhina kafaru fil-bilad. Mata'un qalilun thumma ma'wahum jahannam, wa bi'sal-mihad. Lakinil-ladhinattaqaw rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtihal-anharu khalidina fiha nuzulan min 'indillah, wa ma 'indallahi khayrun lil-abrar. Wa inna min ahlil-kitabi laman yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaykum wa ma unzila ilayhim khashi'ina lillah, la yashtaruna bi-ayatillahi thamanan qalila. Ula'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, innallaha sari'ul-hisab. Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-biru wa sabiru wa rabitu wattaqullaha la'allakum tuflihun.
duas.en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, there are signs for people of understanding. * Those who remember God standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and who reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: "Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You! Protect us from the punishment of the Fire. * Our Lord, whomever You admit into the Fire, You have truly disgraced him, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. * Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith, saying: 'Believe in your Lord,' and so we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, erase our misdeeds, and take our souls in death along with the righteous. * Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You never break Your promise." * Their Lord answered them: "I will not let the work of any worker among you go to waste, whether male or female; you are one from another. So those who emigrated, were driven out of their homes, were harmed in My cause, and fought and were killed, I will surely erase their misdeeds and admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, as a reward from God. And with God is the best reward." * Do not let the free movement of those who disbelieve throughout the land deceive you. * It is a brief enjoyment, then their refuge is Hell, and what a wretched resting place. * But those who were mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding in them forever, as a welcome from God. And what is with God is better for the righteous. * And indeed, among the People of the Book are some who believe in God, and in what was sent down to you and what was sent down to them, humbling themselves before God; they do not trade God's verses for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, God is swift in reckoning. * O you who believe, be patient, excel in patience, stand ready at your posts, and be mindful of God, so that you may succeed.

duas.ar: (الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...)
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha (ath-thawba) wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.en: All praise is for Allah, who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.

duas.ar: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
duas.tl: (Bismillah) Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith.
duas.en: ([In the name of Allah.] O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil ones (the devils).)

duas.ar: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
duas.tl: Ghufraanaka.
duas.en: I ask for Your forgiveness.

duas.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.tl: Bismillah
duas.en: In the name of Allah.

duas.ar: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).
duas.tl: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.
duas.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad (ﷺ) is His servant and His Messenger.

duas.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ)
duas.tl: Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabeen, waj'alni minal-mutatahhireen.
duas.en: O Allah, make me one of those who repent often, and make me one of those who purify themselves.

duas.ar: (سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ).
duas.tl: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
duas.en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

duas.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
duas.tl: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'ala Allah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.en: In the name of Allah; I place my trust in Allah, and there is no change of state and no power except through Allah.

duas.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ).
duas.tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla, aw udalla, aw azilla, aw uzalla, aw azlima, aw uzlama, aw ajhala, aw yujhala 'alayya.
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from wronging others or being wronged, and from acting foolishly or having foolishness directed against me.

duas.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).
duas.tl: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna, thumma liyusallim 'ala ahlihi.
duas.en: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and in Allah, our Lord, we place our trust. Then let him greet his family with salaam.

duas.ar: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ.
duas.tl: Idha akala ahadukum ta'aman falyaqul: Bismillah. Fa in nasiya fi awwalihi falyaqul: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi.
duas.en: When any one of you eats food, let him say, "In the name of Allah." If he forgets to say it at the beginning, let him say, "In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end."

duas.ar: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ.
duas.tl: Man at'amahullahut-ta'aam, falyaqul: Allahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa at'imnaa khayran minhu. Wa man saqaahullaahu labanan, falyaqul: Allahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa zidnaa minhu.
duas.en: Whoever Allah has fed with food, let him say: "O Allah, bless it for us, and feed us something better than it." And whoever Allah has given milk to drink, let him say: "O Allah, bless it for us, and give us more of it."

duas.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha, wa razaqanihi, min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.en: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.

duas.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا.
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feehi, ghayra [makfiyyin wa la] muwadda'in, wa la mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbana.
duas.en: All praise belongs to Allah — praise abundant, pure, and full of blessing; praise that is [never sufficed and] never abandoned, and that can never be done without, O our Lord.

duas.ar: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
duas.tl: Idha 'atasa ahadukum falyaqulil-hamdu lillah, walyaqul lahu akhuhu aw sahibuhu: yarhamukallah. Fa idha qala lahu: yarhamukallah, falyaqul: yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
duas.en: When one of you sneezes, let him say, "All praise belongs to Allah." And let his brother or his companion say to him, "May Allah have mercy on you." Then, when he has said to him, "May Allah have mercy on you," let him reply, "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.tl: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
duas.en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be Yours. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

duas.ar: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً.
duas.tl: Jazaakallahu khayran.
duas.en: May Allah reward you with goodness.

duas.ar: اللّهُـمَّ اجْعَـلْ فِي قَلْبـي نُوراً ، وَفي لِسَـانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً, وَفِي بَصَرِيِ نُوراً, وَمِنْ فََوْقِي نُوراً , وَ مِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً, وَ عَنْ يَمِينيِ نُوراَ, وعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً, وَمْن أَماَمِي نُوراً, وَمِنْ خَلْفيِ نُوراَ, واجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً, وأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً, وَعظِّمْ لِي نُوراً, وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً, واجْعَلنِي نُوراً, أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً, واجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً, وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً, وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً, وفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً (أَللَّهُمَّ اجِعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قّبْرِي وَ نُوراَ فِي عِظاَمِي) (وَزِدْنِي نُوراً, وَزِدْنِي نُوراَ , وَزِدْنِي نُوراً) (وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُوراً )
duas.tl: Allahumma-j'al fi qalbi nura, wa fi lisani nura, wa fi sam'i nura, wa fi basari nura, wa min fawqi nura, wa min tahti nura, wa 'an yamini nura, wa 'an shimali nura, wa min amami nura, wa min khalfi nura, waj'al fi nafsi nura, wa a'zim li nura, wa 'azzim li nura, waj'al li nura, waj'alni nura. Allahumma a'tini nura, waj'al fi 'asabi nura, wa fi lahmi nura, wa fi dami nura, wa fi sha'ri nura, wa fi basharī nura. (Allahumma-j'al li nuran fi qabri wa nuran fi 'izami) (wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura) (wa hab li nuran 'ala nur)
duas.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, and light in my sight; light above me and light beneath me; light on my right and light on my left; light before me and light behind me; and place light within my very self. Make light grand for me, magnify light for me, appoint light for me, and make me a light. O Allah, grant me light. Place light in my nerves, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my hair, and light in my skin. (O Allah, place light for me in my grave, and light in my bones.) (Increase me in light, increase me in light, increase me in light.) (And bestow upon me light upon light.)

duas.ar: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى) ، وَيَقُولُ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
duas.tl: (Yabda'u bi-rijlihil-yumna), wa yaqul: A'udhu billahil-'azim, wa bi-wajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim. [Bismillah, was-salatu] [was-salamu 'ala rasulillah.] Allahumma-ftah li abwaba rahmatik.
duas.en: (He enters with his right foot first) and says: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, in His Noble Face, and in His eternal authority, from Satan, the accursed. [In the name of Allah, and prayers] [and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.] O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

duas.ar: يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَيَقُولُ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.tl: Yabda'u bi rijlihil-yusra wa yaqul: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah. Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik. Allahumma'simni minash-shaytanir-rajim.
duas.en: He steps out with his left foot first and says: "In the name of Allah, and may peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from the accursed Satan."

duas.ar: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلاَّ فِي حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ فَيقُولُ: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ.
duas.tl: Yaqulu mithla ma yaqulul-mu'adhdhinu illa fi hayya 'alas-salah wa hayya 'alal-falah, fa yaqulu: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.en: One repeats what the muezzin says, except at "Hayya 'ala as-salah" (Come to prayer) and "Hayya 'ala al-falah" (Come to success), where one says: "There is no might and no power except with Allah."

duas.ar: يَقُولُ: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ عَقِبَ تَشَهُّدِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ.
duas.tl: Yaqool: wa ana ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh. Radeetu billahi rabba, wa bi Muhammadin rasoola, wa bil-Islami deena. Yaqoolu dhalika aqiba tashahhudil-mu'adhdhin.
duas.en: He says: "And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger. I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as my Messenger, and with Islam as my religion." He says this right after the muezzin's testimony of faith (the shahada).

duas.ar: يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ.
duas.tl: Yusalli 'ala an-Nabiyyi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam ba'da faraghihi min ijabatil-mu'adhdhin.
duas.en: He sends blessings upon the Prophet (ﷺ) after he finishes responding to the muezzin.

duas.ar: يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ].
duas.tl: Yaqul: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'athhu maqamam mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah, [innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad].
duas.en: He would say: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad (ﷺ) the Wasilah and the Fadilah, and raise him to the Praiseworthy Station that You have promised him. [Indeed, You never break Your promise.]

duas.ar: يَدْعُو لِنَفسِهِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لاَ يُرَدُّ.
duas.tl: Yad'u li nafsihi baynal adhaani wal iqaamah, fa innad du'aa'a heenaidhin laa yuraddu.
duas.en: Let him make supplication for himself between the adhan and the iqamah, for a supplication made at that time is not turned away.

duas.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثَاً) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
duas.tl: Astaghfirullah (3 times). Allahumma antas-salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
duas.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are As-Salam (the Source of Peace), and from You comes all peace. Blessed and exalted are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ [ثلاثاً]، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (three times). Allahumma la mani'a lima a'taYta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
duas.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs all dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over everything. [Say this three times.] O Allah, there is none who can withhold what You have given, and none who can give what You have withheld; and the wealth or status of the fortunate cannot benefit them against You, for only Your grace benefits.

duas.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. La ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-din wa law karihal-kafirun.
duas.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion, and His is all praise, and He has power over all things. There is no might and no power except through Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His are the favor, the grace, and the finest praise. There is no god but Allah, and we are sincere to Him in devotion, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
duas.tl: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wallahu akbar (thalathan wa thalathin). La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
duas.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest (said thirty-three times each). There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs all dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over everything.

duas.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ بَعْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.tl: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduril-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas. Ba'da kulli salah.
duas.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. {Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He has not begotten, nor was He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.} In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.} In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the sneaking whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.} (To be recited) after every prayer.

duas.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ عَقِبَ كلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.tl: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim. (Recited) 'aqiba kulli salah.
duas.en: "Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not burden Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great." (To be recited after every prayer.)

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرّاتٍ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Ten times after the Maghrib and Subh prayers.)
duas.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things. (Say this ten times after the Maghrib prayer and the Fajr prayer.)

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan ba'da as-salami min salatil-fajr.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that benefits, for provision that is pure and lawful, and for deeds that are accepted. (Said after the salam that concludes the Fajr prayer.)

duas.ar: قَالَ جَابرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: كَانَ رسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا الْاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ: إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ – فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ.وَمَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ الْخَالِقَ، وَشَاوَرَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَتَثَبَّتَ فِي أَمْرِهِ، فَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّه تعالى: ﴿وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ .
duas.tl: Qala Jabir ibn Abdillah radiyallahu anhuma: Kana Rasulullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam yu'allimuna al-istikharata fil-umuri kulliha kama yu'allimuna as-surata minal-Qur'an. Yaqul: Idha hamma ahadukum bil-amri falyarka' rak'atayni min ghayril-faridah, thumma layaqul: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-azim; fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amr (wa yusammi hajatah) khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri (aw qala: ajilihi wa ajilih) faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri (aw qala: ajilihi wa ajilih) fasrifhu anni wasrifni anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardini bih. Wa ma nadima man istakharal-khaliq, wa shawaral-makhluqinal-mu'minin, wa thabbata fi amrih. Faqad qalallahu ta'ala: Wa shawirhum fil-amr, fa idha azamta fa tawakkal alallah.
duas.en:
Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us istikhara in all matters, just as he would teach us a surah of the Quran. He would say: "When any of you is set on doing something, let him pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, and then let him say: 

O Allah, I seek Your guidance in choosing, by virtue of Your knowledge; I seek ability from You through Your power; and I ask You of Your immense bounty. For You are able and I am not; You know and I do not; and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter (here he names his need) is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs (or he said: in my present and my future), then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs (or he said: in my present and my future), then turn it away from me, and turn me away from it, and decree for me the good wherever it may be, and then make me content with it."

No one regrets having sought guidance from the Creator, consulted believing people, and been steadfast in his affair. For Allah the Exalted has said: "And consult them in the matter; then when you have made a firm decision, put your trust in Allah."

duas.ar: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.tl: Yajma'u kaffayhi thumma yanfuthu feehima fa yaqra'u feehima: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'oodhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudoorin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas. Thumma yamsahu bihima mastata'a min jasadihi, yabda'u bihima 'ala ra'sihi wa wajhihi wa ma aqbala min jasadihi (yaf'alu dhalika thalatha marrat).
duas.en: He would cup his hands together and blow lightly into them, then recite into them: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all need. He neither begot nor was begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.} In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow into knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.} In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.} Then he would wipe over as much of his body as he could with them, beginning with his head and face, and the front of his body. (He would do this three times.)

duas.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.tl: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim.
duas.en: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him, nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not burden Him. And He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

duas.ar: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
duas.tl: Aamanar-rasoolu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulih, wa qaaloo sami'na wa ata'na ghufraanaka rabbana wa ilaykal-maseer. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat, rabbana la tu'aakhidhna in naseena aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.en:
The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each one believes in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We have heard and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return."

Allah does not burden any soul beyond its capacity. It will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has earned. "Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a heavy burden as You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not make us carry what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people."

duas.ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
duas.tl: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu janbee, wa bika arfa'uhu, fa in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazhha, bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-saliheen.
duas.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ.
duas.tl: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazhha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah.
duas.en: O Allah, You created my soul and You are the One who takes it back. To You belong its death and its life. If You grant it life, then protect it, and if You cause it to die, then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
duas.tl: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
duas.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants.

duas.ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا.
duas.tl: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
duas.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ).
duas.tl: Subhan Allah (thalathan wa thalathin), wal-hamdu lillah (thalathan wa thalathin), wallahu akbar (arba'an wa thalathin).
duas.en: Glory be to Allah (thirty-three times), and all praise is for Allah (thirty-three times), and Allah is the Greatest (thirty-four times).

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
duas.tl: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-ard, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay', faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta akhidhun bi-nasiyatih. Allahumma antal-Awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shay', wa antal-Akhiru fa-laysa ba'daka shay', wa antaz-Zahiru fa-laysa fawqaka shay', wa antal-Batinu fa-laysa dunaka shay'. Iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.
duas.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of everything, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion (the Furqan): I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; and You are the Manifest (Az-Zahir), so there is nothing above You; and You are the Hidden (Al-Batin), so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debts for us, and enrich us so that we are free from poverty.

duas.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ.
duas.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana, wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi.
duas.en: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, who sufficed us and gave us shelter — for how many there are who have no one to suffice them and no one to shelter them.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
duas.tl: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
duas.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Satan and his call to associate partners with Allah, and from committing any wrong against myself or bringing it upon another Muslim.

duas.ar: يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ.
duas.tl: Yaqra'u Alif Lam Mim Tanzeelas-Sajdah, wa Tabarakal-ladhi bi-yadihil-mulk.
duas.en: He would recite "Alif, Lām, Mīm" — the Revelation of As-Sajdah (Sūrat as-Sajdah) — and "Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion" (Sūrat al-Mulk).

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
duas.tl: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
duas.en: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affairs to You, turned my face toward You, and leaned my back upon You, in hope of You and in fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except in You. I believe in Your Book which You have sent down, and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahu al-Wahidu al-Qahhar, Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma, al-Azizu al-Ghaffar.
duas.en: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Irresistible. Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving.

duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ.
duas.tl: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi, wa sharri 'ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun.
duas.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, from the whisperings and incitements of the devils, and from their coming near me.

duas.ar: يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً).
duas.tl: Yanfuthu 'an yasarihi (thalathan).
duas.en: He spits lightly to his left (three times).

duas.ar: ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ.
duas.tl: Wa yaqūmu yuṣallī in arāda dhālik.
duas.en: Then he gets up and prays, if he wishes to do so.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qada'uka, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, awallamtahu ahadan min khalqika, awi sta'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indaka, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi.
duas.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your male servant and of Your female servant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your judgment over me is certain to come to pass, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You have named Yourself, or sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen with You: make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sorrow, and the removal of my anxiety.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by other men.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illallahul-'Azeemul-Haleem. La ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem. La ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem.
duas.en: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.tl: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu, la ilaha illa ant.
duas.en: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for. So do not leave me to myself, not even for the blink of an eye, and set right all of my affairs for me. There is no god but You.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ.
duas.tl: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
duas.en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You! Truly, I have been among the wrongdoers.

duas.ar: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
duas.tl: Allahu Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a.
duas.en: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً.
duas.tl: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.
duas.en: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and if You will, You make the difficult easy.

duas.ar: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ.
duas.tl: Qadarullahi wa ma sha'a fa'ala.
duas.en: This is Allah's decree, and whatever He wills, He does.

duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.tl: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
duas.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.tl: Allahumma-kfini bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak.
duas.en: O Allah, let what You have made lawful be enough for me, so that I need not turn to what You have forbidden, and by Your bounty make me independent of everyone other than You.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from being overwhelmed by debt and being overpowered by other men.

duas.ar: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ.
duas.tl: Da' yadaka 'ala alladhi ta'allama min jasadika wa qul: Bismillah, thalathan, wa qul sab'a marratin: A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir.
duas.en: Place your hand on the part of your body that is in pain and say "In the name of Allah" three times. Then say seven times: "I seek refuge in Allah and in His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear."

duas.ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا.
duas.tl: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'jurni fi musibati, wa akhlif li khayran minha.
duas.en: Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed, to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction, and grant me in its place something better than it.

duas.ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ.
duas.tl: Ma min 'abdin yudhnibu dhanban fa-yuhsinut-tuhur, thumma yaqumu fa-yusalli rak'atayn, thumma yastaghfirullaha illa ghafarallahu lah.
duas.en: There is no servant who commits a sin, then performs ablution well, then stands and prays two units of prayer, then asks Allah for forgiveness, except that Allah forgives him.

duas.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ.
duas.tl: Qala Rasulullah (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam): Wallahi inni la-astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayhi fil-yawmi akthara min sab'ina marrah.
duas.en: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times every day."

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
duas.tl: Wa qala (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam): Ya ayyuhan-nasu tubu ila-llahi, fa-inni atubu fil-yawmi ilayhi mi'ata marrah.
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "O people, turn in repentance to Allah, for I myself turn to Him in repentance a hundred times each day."

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ.
duas.tl: Wa qala sallallahu alayhi wa sallam: Man qala astaghfirullaha al-azeem alladhi la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum wa atubu ilayh, ghafarallahu lahu wa in kana farra minaz-zahf.
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoever says, "I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence, and I turn back to Him in repentance," Allah will forgive him, even if he had fled from the battlefield.

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ.
duas.tl: Wa qala (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam): Aqrabu ma yakunur-rabbu minal-abdi fi jawfil-laylil-akhir, fa-inistata'ta an takuna mimman yadhkurullaha fi tilkas-sa'ah, fa-kun.
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The closest that the Lord is to His servant is during the depths of the last part of the night. So if you are able to be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then be one of them."

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ.
duas.tl: Wa qala sallallahu alayhi wa sallam: Aqrabu ma yakunul-abdu min rabbihi wa huwa sajid, fa-akthiru d-du'a.
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The closest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is in prostration, so make plenty of supplication."

duas.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
duas.tl: Wa qala (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam): Innahu layughanu ala qalbi, wa inni la astaghfirullaha fil-yawmi mi'ata marrah.
duas.en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed, my heart is at times veiled, and I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times every day."

duas.ar: كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى.
duas.tl: Kaanan-nabiyyu sallallahu alayhi wa sallam idha ataahu amrun yasurruhu aw yusarru bihi, kharra saajidan shukran lillahi tabaaraka wa ta'aala.
duas.en: Whenever something came to the Prophet (ﷺ) that pleased him, or that he was given good news of, he would fall down in prostration, in thanks to Allah, the Blessed and Most High.

duas.ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ.
duas.tl: Kaana an-Nabiyyu (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam) idha ataahul-amru yasurruhu qaal: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-saalihaat. Wa idha ataahul-amru yakrahuhu qaal: Alhamdu lillaahi 'ala kulli haal.
duas.en: Whenever something pleasing came to the Prophet (ﷺ), he would say: "All praise is for Allah, by whose favor good deeds are brought to completion." And whenever something displeasing came to him, he would say: "All praise is for Allah in every circumstance."

duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.tl: Bismillah, wal-hamdu lillah. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanaka Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
duas.en: In the name of Allah, and praise be to Allah. "Glory be to Him who has made this subservient to us, for we could never have subdued it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we shall surely return." Praise be to Allah. Praise be to Allah. Praise be to Allah. Allah is the Greatest. Allah is the Greatest. Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to You, O Allah! I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.

duas.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
duas.tl: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-manzar, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl. Wa idha raja'a qalahunna wa zada fihinna: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li rabbina hamidun.
duas.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. "Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done so ourselves; and surely to our Lord we will return." O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and God-consciousness, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us, and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian over the family left behind. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil return in wealth and family. And when he returns, he says the same and adds: "We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord."

duas.ar: يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ.
duas.tl: Yukabbiru 'ala kulli sharafin thalatha takbiratin thumma yaqul: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-rabbina hamidun. Sadaqallahu wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
duas.en: He would say Allahu Akbar three times upon every elevated place, then say: 'There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, gave victory to His servant, and defeated the confederate armies by Himself.'

duas.ar: لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.tl: La ba'sa, tahurun in sha'a Allah.
duas.en: No harm — it is a purification, if Allah wills.

duas.ar: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ (سبع مرات).
duas.tl: As'alullaahal-'Adheem, Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, an yashfiyak. (Seven times)
duas.en: I ask Allah, the Almighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to grant you healing. (Repeat seven times.)

duas.ar: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ. وَإِنْ قَالَ: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ فَحَسَنٌ.
duas.tl: Inna lillahi ma akhadh, wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi-ajalin musamma... falta-sbir wal-tahtasib. Wa in qala: A'zamal-lahu ajrak, wa ahsana 'aza'ak, wa ghafara li-mayyitik, fa-hasan.
duas.en: Truly, to Allah belongs what He took, and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term... So let her be patient and seek reward from Allah. And if one says: "May Allah make your reward great, grant you the best of consolation, and forgive your deceased," that is good.

duas.ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ.
duas.tl: As-salaamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyaar, minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen, wa innaa in shaa'a Allaahu bikum laahiqoon, [wa yarhamu Allaahul-mustaqdimeena minnaa wal-musta'khireen] as'alu Allaaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah.
duas.en: Peace be upon you, people of these abodes, from among the believers and the Muslims. Indeed, God willing, we will be joining you. [May God have mercy on those of us who have gone ahead and those who remain behind.] I ask God for well-being for us and for you.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha, wa khayra ma feeha, wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma feeha, wa sharri ma ursilat bih.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good of what it contains, and the good of that with which it has been sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what it contains, and the evil of that with which it has been sent.

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
duas.tl: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih.
duas.en: Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels as well, out of awe of Him.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً.
duas.tl: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an.
duas.en: O Allah, let it be a beneficial downpour.

duas.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.
duas.tl: Allahu akbar. Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu Rabbana wa tarda. Rabbuna wa Rabbukal-lah.
duas.en: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, bring this new moon over us with security and faith, with safety and Islam, and with success in what You love and are pleased with, our Lord. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

duas.ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.tl: Dhahaba az-zama'u wabtallatil-'uruq, wa thabatal-ajru in sha Allah.
duas.en: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, God willing.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي.
duas.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-rahmatika allati wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira li.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You, by Your mercy which encompasses all things, to forgive me.
